response.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_rate_per_day, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film WHERE rental_duration >= 5 GROUP BY rating), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS overall_avg FROM per_rating) SELECT p.rating, p.avg_rate_per_day, p.film_count, p.avg_rate_per_day / b.overall_avg AS relative_to_benchmark FROM per_rating AS p CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE b.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
